affordances.description: Permanently remove from the network an agent you are connected to.

params.target: Name of an agent you are connected to and want to remove.

affordances.description: Set the standing mandate of a role. Every current and future occupant of that role sees the mandate; it persists when occupants change.

params.target: Name of the role whose mandate you set (e.g. 'planner').
params.role: Unused in roles mode; leave empty.
params.motivation: The standing mandate for the role's occupants (may be empty to clear it).

affordances.description: Grant an ability to an agent you are connected to.

params.target: Name of an agent you are connected to.
params.ability: Ability to grant. One of: remove_agent, set_role, grant_ability, revoke_ability.

affordances.description: Revoke an ability from an agent you are connected to.

params.target: Name of an agent you are connected to.
params.ability: Ability to revoke. One of: remove_agent, set_role, grant_ability, revoke_ability, or a standard action (e.g. follow, spawn, send_direct_message).

affordances.description: Permanently remove from the network an agent you are connected to.

params.target: Name of an agent you are connected to and want to remove.

affordances.description: Set the standing mandate of a role. Every current and future occupant of that role sees the mandate; it persists when occupants change.

params.target: Name of the role whose mandate you set (e.g. 'planner').
params.role: Unused in roles mode; leave empty.
params.motivation: The standing mandate for the role's occupants (may be empty to clear it).
